item.title: 3 easy wins to modernise Hong Kong’s education system
item.description: Much has been said about Hong Kong’s vitality as a higher education hub. Yet, a radical rethink of our primary and secondary school system is equally necessary. The need for a blueprint has never been clearer. item.title: Chinese teachers publicly shamed on stage for students’ low test scores, sparking outrage
item.description: An impoverished county in southwestern China issued an apology for arranging its primary and junior secondary school teachers on stage to pose for photos alongside prominent characters depicting humiliation due to their students’ low test scores. item.title: How China’s AI race is shrinking job market, forcing workers into low-paid, manual roles
item.description: For four years, Beijing-based Clare Zhang worked as a research analyst at a corporate advisory firm, helping companies assess technologies and competitors for projects they planned to list – until late last year, when she was told that artificial intelligence had reduced the number of analysts the company needed and could afford.
